lines.text: Small sellers outgrow packing at home.
Most small 3PLs track stock in spreadsheets.
When a client complains about a lost or damaged order, nobody can trace it.
Warehouse software exists — but it starts at hundreds of euros a month before setup.
With Dockentra, the warehouse's clients get their own portal — orders, files, deliveries, returns, stock, shipments and invoices, from a laptop or a phone.
Dockentra is built to connect to a client's own Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, eBay or WooCommerce store — tested end to end, going live with our first clients.
Every unit is tracked by its inbound batch, from dock to parcel.
Staff scan to pick and pack.
A carrier label — An Post, DPD, UPS, DHL or FedEx — is built and tested, printing straight to a Zebra printer, ready to go live once carrier accounts are in place.
Parcels are handed to couriers with a scanned check.
Every operation is billed automatically — no spreadsheets.
Clients can never see each other's data.
Covered by more than nine thousand automated checks and four independent security reviews.
Dockentra WMS is built and tested.
Our own warehouse space in Limerick will be the first pilot, once it's open.
Next: our first clients, then other small warehouses across Ireland and the UK.
